note: Written BEFORE the copilot parser. 'dev' prompts (1-20) may be used while building the parser; 'heldout' prompts (21-30) are run once at the end and reported separately. Expected values omit defaults: use_forecast=false, enrollment_growth=[], buyouts=[], coverage_strategy='overload', room_capacity_scale=1.0, change_policy='minimal', blocked_room_slots=[]. 'as' = the signed-in faculty member (first-person prompts). 'unsupported' = the whole request is out of scope, so the spec must stay at the defaults and a warning must be returned.
